main_text.head: Magniff. VV. D. Johanni-Rodolfo Hubero, Basileensis Reip. Consuli prudentiss. D. Andreae Ryff, ejusdem Senatori amplissimo. Ecclesiae itē Scholaeq; Deputato Curatori fidissimo.
main_text.p: Dominis ac Mæcenatibus meis summopere colendis: S. P.

Nos ἀτόπῃ ἀοθέντος, τ' ἄλλα συμβαίνει: (uno inconveniente admisso, subsequuntur plura.) non tam vetus & tritum, quàm verum est dictum: (Prudentiss. Amplissimq; Viri) cujus veritatem indies tristi nimis experientiâ experimur; in ea etiam doctrina, quæ est secundùm pietatē. Ecce enim, vix renasci quasi atq; è plùs-quàm-Cimmeriis Papatus tenebris emergere incipit pura Euangelii lucerna; dum aperta vi Satan horridus restinguere nō valet, mille-artifex dolis ac fraudibus, in Angelu lucis sese transformans, sub speciosso Veritatis titulo nebulas ei ofi
main_text.notes: Initial "E" is a decorated woodcut letter. Greek words in the opening sentence are transcribed as printed; the Greek may contain errors. Running head, page number and catchword are absent. The heading block is set in large type and is presented as a single level 1 head. The signature "A 2" is printed at the foot.
